newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended higher for the sixth day in a row in mostly dealer-driven trade underpinned by declines in some swap rates.

The market was somewhat edgy awaiting the outcome of Tuesday's and Wednesday's Federal Open Market Committee meeting. Investors were also favouring yields above 4.00 percent, which are increasingly hard to find.

One trader said that lately investors had begun to waver, buying some bonds with yields below 4.00 percent, such as a 10-year bond issued January 23 by the Canton of Geneva, with a four percent coupon.
March Comi medium-term bond steady at 111.30
Mar Euro Swiss francs down three at 98.26.
